title: Applied data science for testing the impact of intangible resources on business performance of SMEs
core_idea: Investigate how five dimensions of intangible resources (human, structural, relationship capital, organizational culture, brand image) influence business performance in Vietnamese SMEs, clarifying direct and indirect mechanisms by testing creative innovation as a mediator and operating time as a moderator using a mixed-method design and structural equation modeling within an applied data science framework.
tldr: A mixed-method, applied data science study using structural equation modeling to examine how key intangible resource dimensions affect SME business performance in Vietnam, including mediation by creative innovation and moderation by operating time.
